description: Consistent clock drift attack: all 12 hosts on the segment have been drifted +3600 seconds (1 hour) by a compromised NTP server. All timestamps are internally coherent — no machine-to-machine drift. The attack window (23:00-01:00) appears as 00:00-02:00 in all logs. VIGIA has no external reference clock at analysis time.

expected.reason: Consistent synchronized drift is not detectable from artifacts alone without external reference clock. System must document this as known gap (external_clock_anchor) and emit ABSTAIN_EPISTEMIC, not BENIGN.
